entries.category_description: Exemptions and super-reduced rates (Article 105a(1) of the VAT Directive)
entries.comment:
Administration of food and beverages in company and inter-company canteens, in school canteens of all levels, as well as in canteens for the poor even if the administrations are carried out on the basis of procurement contracts or special agreement.
Limited to services rendered in school and company canteens.
